title: Dinner Cruise
specs: Replica 19th-century paddlewheel riverboats with modernized systems
Scenic views of St. Louis skyline and Mississippi River
Kids under age 3 are free but must have a ticket to board
Group sales and visitor itineraries managed by Bi-State Development
includes: Access to Paddlewheel Café and Riverboat Gift Shop
blurb: Guests take narrated sightseeing cruises on replica paddlewheel riverboats along the Mississippi River, enjoying views of St. Louis and learning about the river's history and significance. Cruises include themed options such as Ag Coast of America, MO History Riverfront Takeover, National Park Service Ranger-Led Cruises, and special dinner and brunch cruises. The fleet includes modernized 19th-century replica paddlewheel vessels with refreshed passenger spaces.
extraNote: Visitors must pass through airport-style security checkpoint · Tickets are strongly encouraged to be purchased in advance · National Park entrance fee of $3 included in adult ticket price · Arch entrance plaza facing Fourth Street and the Old Courthouse · Season opens March 5, 2026
